$$\boxed{\dfrac{3^{2023}+3}{4};\ \dfrac{3^{2023}-1}{4};\ \dfrac{3^{2023}+1}{2}}$$

**Derivation:** The three conditions characterize the Cantor (Devil's staircase) function. Let $T_n=\sum_{\substack{1\le k\le 3^n\\k\text{ odd}}}f(k/3^n)$ and $U_n=\sum_{k=1}^{3^n}f(k/3^n)$. By $f(1-x)=1-f(x)$, pairing $k$ with $3^n-k$ gives $U_n=\frac{3^n+1}{2}$.

Split the odd $k$ into three blocks:
- $k\le 3^{n-1}$: $f(k/3^n)=\tfrac12 f(k/3^{n-1})$, contributing $\tfrac12 T_{n-1}$.
- $3^{n-1}<k<2\cdot3^{n-1}$: $k/3^n\in(\tfrac13,\tfrac23)$, so $f=\tfrac12$; there are $\frac{3^{n-1}-1}{2}$ such terms, contributing $\frac{3^{n-1}-1}{4}$.
- $k\ge 2\cdot3^{n-1}$: write $k=3^n-j$ with $j$ even, $0\le j\le 3^{n-1}-1$. Then $f(k/3^n)=1-f(j/3^n)=1-\tfrac12 f(j/3^{n-1})$ (for $j>0$), contributing $\frac{3^{n-1}+1}{2}-\tfrac12 E_{n-1}$, where $E_{n-1}=U_{n-1}-T_{n-1}$.

Summing: $T_n=\tfrac12T_{n-1}+\tfrac{3^{n-1}-1}{4}+\tfrac{3^{n-1}+1}{2}-\tfrac12\!\left(\tfrac{3^{n-1}+1}{2}-T_{n-1}\right)=T_{n-1}+\tfrac{3^{n-1}}{2}$.
With $T_1=f(1/3)+f(1)=\tfrac32$, we get $T_n=\tfrac32+\tfrac12\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}3^i=\dfrac{3^n+3}{4}$.

Thus for $n=2023$: odd-sum $=\frac{3^{2023}+3}{4}$, even-sum $=U_{2023}-T_{2023}=\frac{3^{2023}-1}{4}$, total $=\frac{3^{2023}+1}{2}$.
